query: For high-entropy alloys, what single intervention could improve dynamic strength–ductility performance? Formulate one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains its mechanism, predicts the improvement relative to an untreated baseline, defines the boundary conditions under which it should hold, cites supporting prior evidence, and proposes a decisive experiment that could falsify it.

evidence_appraisal.reason: similar crystal structure and deformation mechanisms
different crystal structure and ordering behavior
similar strengthening mechanisms and microstructure evolution
similar grain-boundary strengthening and dislocation-strengthening mechanisms

generation.hypothesis: Grain refinement through severe plastic deformation can improve dynamic strength-ductility performance in high-entropy alloys.
generation.mechanism: Derived from materials-science principles, as grain refinement and increased dislocation density can lead to improved strength and ductility through dislocation strengthening, grain boundary strengthening, and enhanced work hardening.
generation.predicted_outcome: improved dynamic strength-ductility performance, with a predicted increase in yield strength of 20-30% and uniform elongation of 10-20% compared to the untreated baseline
generation.baseline: as-cast or powder metallurgy processed high-entropy alloys without severe plastic deformation
generation.boundary: high-entropy alloys with FCC or BCC crystal structures, processed through severe plastic deformation at room temperature
generation.uncertainty: the exact magnitude of improvement may vary depending on the specific composition and processing conditions of the high-entropy alloy

falsification_experiment.design: compare the dynamic strength-ductility performance of high-entropy alloys with and without severe plastic deformation
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: if the severely plastically deformed high-entropy alloy does not exhibit improved dynamic strength-ductility performance compared to the untreated baseline, the hypothesis is falsified

- finding (from "Simultaneously enhancing the ultimate strength and ductility of ...", 2021): showed that the high strength of a CoCu0.7FeNiAl0.3 HEA arose primarily from grain-boundary strengthening and dislocation-strengthening mechanisms [system CoCu0.7FeNiAl0.3 HEA]
- finding (from "Combining Machine Learning and Molecular Dynamics to Predict ...", 2023): studied a novel single-phase Co25Ni25Fe25Al7.5Cu17.5 HEA prepared by mechanical alloying and discharge plasma sintering and found that its high yield strength and hardness were attributed to the strengthening of grain boundary and dislocation [system Co25Ni25Fe25Al7.5Cu17.5 HEA]
